scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api && npm run build:verification && npm run build:mcp-connector
scripts.build:verification: npm run build --workspace @agentpay/verify-node && npm run test:verification:extended
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:go
scripts.test: npm run test:dev-local && npm run test:terraform-layout && npm run test:terraform-state-bootstrap && npm run test:terraform-dynamodb && npm run test:terraform-evidence && npm run test:web && npm run test:go && npm run test:verification && npm run test:mcp-connector
scripts.test:verification: npm run test --workspace @agentpay/verify-node && node scripts/run-python-verification-tests.mjs && npm run test:verification:extended
scripts.quality:launch: npm run test:e2e && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @agentpay/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @agentpay/verify-node && npm run typecheck:mcp-connector
scripts.terraform:check: terraform -chdir=infra/terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform init -backend=false && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform validate
